client_secret.description: Write-only. Omit to keep the stored secret; empty string clears it.

client_secret_ref.description: External reference instead of a stored secret: env:WAGENPULSE_SECRET_NAME or file:/run/secrets/…

allow_insecure_transport.description: Permit plaintext nats:// to non-loopback hosts in production.

ca_pem.description: Extra PEM CA trusted for the NATS TLS certificate.

include_vin.description: Add the VIN to published envelopes (off by default: VINs are personal data).

max_attempts.description: Attempts before a delivery becomes dead (1..100).

subject_domain.description: Second subject token (default wagenpulse); the Pulse client needs publish:evt.<domain>.>.

subject_template.description: Placeholders {domain}, {event}, {vehicle}, {rule}, {severity}; must render a valid Pulse subject.

url.description: nats:// or tls:// URL of the Pulse NATS endpoint.

confirm.description: Must be true; purging cannot be undone.

delete_vehicle.description: Also delete the archived vehicle record.

include_backfill.description: Also deliver events created from historical imports and reprocessing (default false, ADR-0017).

rule_ids.description: Rules whose events are delivered (empty = all rules).

vehicle_ids.description: Vehicles whose events are delivered (empty = all).

revision.description: Current definition revision; events reference it.

confirm.description: Must be true: data past retention is deleted irreversibly.

token.description: One-time token from 'wagenpulse admin setup-token' on the host.

observed_name.description: dataFieldName seen in deliveries when it differs from the dictionary name.

interface.description: Always 'unofficial': the portal's web backend is not a documented API (ADR-0005).

portal_brand_key.description: Brand key from the portal login URL (needed for password login of some brands).

secret.description: Write-only: the password, or the portal session cookie header value; omit to keep, empty clears.

secret_ref.description: External reference instead of a stored secret (env:WAGENPULSE_SECRET_… or file:…). Send it on every update.

username.description: Write-only account email for password login; omit to keep.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID of the last collection run; the server log lines of that run carry it.

lag_seconds.description: Seconds since the last successful collection.

hint.description: Non-secret prefix of the token (wgp_at_<lookup>_…) to recognize it.

expires_in_days.description: Default from system settings; omit for never_expires.

never_expires.description: Root only, interactive only. The token stays valid until revoked; store it in a secret manager and rotate it deliberately.

scopes.description: Permissions granted to the token; you must hold each one. Effective permissions are always limited by your current role.

vehicle_ids.description: Restrict the token to these vehicles (empty = all).

password.description: Initial local password (write-only, min 12 bytes). Omit for SSO-only users.

role.description: Default viewer. Only root may create admins.

password.description: Reset the local password (write-only); signs the user out everywhere.

slug.description: Lowercase identifier used in event subjects (never the VIN).

stale_after_minutes.description: Override of the system stale threshold for this vehicle.

info.description: Versioned API of WagenPulse, shared by the web UI, automation and the Terraform provider. Browser clients authenticate with the session cookie and send the session's CSRF token in X-CSRF-Token on state-changing requests. Automation uses `Authorization: Bearer wgp_at_…` API tokens (never in URLs). When both a bearer token and a session cookie are present, only the token is used. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents with a stable `code`. Mutable resources carry an ETag; send it in If-Match to avoid lost updates (412 on mismatch). POST requests accept Idempotency-Key for safe retries.
